component.name: Octa
component.summary: View, edit and query data files

description.p: Octa opens a data file in a spreadsheet-like table with sorting, filtering and search. Edit cells in place, insert or delete rows and columns, find and replace or transform a column, all with undo, then save in the original format or convert to another one.
Any open table can be reshaped with SQL through DuckDB: aggregate it, join it with another file, and keep the result as a new tab or write it to a file or a database.

ul.li: CSV, Parquet, Excel, JSON, Arrow, Avro, ORC, SQLite, DuckDB and many more formats
Live databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQL Server
Files on S3, Azure, Google Cloud Storage, SFTP and WebDAV
Charts, summaries, file comparison and data quality checks
